Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment uses activity-based covalent probes (phosphoribosyl ubiquitin probes) to enrich for Dup enzymes. While the probes target a specific non-canonical ubiquitination mechanism (PR-ubiquitination), the overall workflow is a pull-down (AP-MS style) followed by bottom-up DDA-LFQ. mod_ubiquitin is suggested due to the use of ubiquitin-based probes and the study of ubiquitination pathways, although it is a probe-based capture rather than a diGly-remnant enrichment.

Streptavidin-agarose resin was equilibrated in lysis buffer. 30 μl of equilibrated resin was added to the lysate-probe mixture

the resin was washed with wash buffer (Tris 20 mM, NaCl 150 mM, pH 7.5, 2% SDS) by centrifuging at 500 rcf for 1 min followed by removal of the supernatant. The wash was repeated 6 times; the resin was then transferred to new microfuge tubes and boiled in SDS with ʲ-mercaptoethanol for 15 min.
